commentary.text: Short, wide outside off. Slapped violently through backward point! The ropes take a beating as Dread Eleven seal the historic derby triumph in front of a roaring crowd!
Full and angled into the middle stump. Driven cleanly down to long-on for a sharp single. Brings the skipper back on strike for the final delivery.
MASSIVE! Pitched right into the slot, cleared the front leg and launched into the top tier over wide long-on! 98 meters of pure authority.
Searing toe-crusher at 142 km/h. Jammed out towards mid-wicket. Dot ball under extreme pressure.
OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Attempted the ramp over short fine leg, mistimed the bouncer and spooned a simple catch to short third man.
CRUNCHED! Back of a length outside off, opened the blade and carved it through the gap between cover and point for FOUR.
Flicked off the pads neatly towards deep square leg. Good hard running between the wickets pushes the target within touching distance.
DISPATCHED! 145 clicks on the speed gun, but Akhil Mishra stands tall and pulls it flat over deep midwicket into the pavilion!
